description: The acts that amend, correct (corrigenda) or repeal an EU act, from LexAPI's citation graph, with the act's title, dates, in-force status today and end of validity. Limits of the data: a relation carries no date, so each entry has the year of its CELEX number (corrigenda have none) and a document date only where dates read it, and since filters on those; a partial repeal is recorded as an amendment; relations are as current as their last refresh (completeness); consolidated versions are shown only when the API reports them ("not_reported" otherwise), never as a full list. An empty list is not proof that nothing changed. Cost: 1 credit per page of relations, plus the act's metadata (1 credit from the corpus, 4 via the Publications Office, 5 live), plus the same for each date read (dates, default 0, at most 10): 2–6 credits without dates, at most 56.

celexNumber.description: CELEX number of the act, e.g. 32016R0679; a consolidated CELEX is read as its base act.

dates.description: Read the document date of up to this many listed acts (one metadata read each), first those the year cannot place.

since.description: Keep changes from this date on (YYYY-MM-DD): by CELEX year, and by document date where one was read.

name: lex_act_history
title: Changes to an EU act
